summary: Andrea Kimi Antonelli's 111-point lead over Max Verstappen faces its sternest test yet as Verstappen starts from pole position despite Antonelli's faster qualifying lap, with the Mercedes driver's grid penalty handing the Red Bull driver a crucial advantage on the Vegas strip. George Russell's pace in practice signals Mercedes' continued strength in the constructors' battle against Ferrari, setting up a tense weekend in the fight for second place in the team standings. With two races remaining after Las Vegas, Antonelli's commanding championship margin means every point matters—a win here would move him closer to sealing Mercedes' first constructors' title this season.
